blocks.x: Are you ready to wrap up? Okay. We’ll just go ahead. We’ll call this – don’t stop it yet, because I want to identify everybody that’s in the room, because you’ve been speaking.
This is completing the – third tape?

. . . third tape of the first day of the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History interview with Louie Bellson at his home in San Jose. He is being interviewed by Anthony Brown and also Ken Kimery of the Smithsonian Institution. We’ll continue again tomorrow.
Great. I’m looking forward to it.

Today is October 21st. We’re continuing with day two of our Smithsonian Jazz Oral History interview with Louie Bellson in his home in San Jose, California. Good morning, Louie. Once again, here we are.
